metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for the Konductor platform and for Nix/commit engineering.

plugins.name: konductor
plugins.description: Konductor NixOS/QCOW2/KubeVirt platform skills and agents: Pulumi IaC (preview/up, provider SDKs, pyright typechecker), Talos/KubeVirt cluster ops (talosctl, virtctl, context/UID failures), runme task pipelines (docs/ci, cwd/shell frontmatter), and QCOW2 image builds (cloud-init, systemd user services, skel provisioning). Includes read-only k8s-debugger and preview-only pulumi-engineer agents, secret-scan and nix-fmt hooks, and a Nix LSP.

plugins.name: konductor-practitioner
plugins.description: Authoring discipline for Nix and for commits, usable in any repository. nix-idioms: write and review derivations, flake modules, and config generation (formats.json over toJSON, lib.getExe, linkFarm vs symlinkJoin, makeExtensible, freeformType, content-addressed fetches). git-commit: conventional-commit ceremony with full-diff reading, capacity gates, and diff-derived objective messages, plus a non-blocking commit guard that defers to a repository's own contributing conventions.
